description:
Four places convert failures into silent absence or garbage:
1. get_query_plan_from_cursor returns "Could not get query plan: <exc>" AS
   the plan text (sql_execution.py:29-30) — displayed as a plan; would be
   parsed as one if those platforms ever join capture.
2. Corrupt .plans.json logged at DEBUG (loader.py:172-179) — user is told
   "no plans captured, re-run with --capture-plans" for a file problem.
3. DataFrame capture exceptions logged at debug with no error record
   (expression_family.py:1433-1437) — companion errors show generic
   "Query plan not captured" instead of the real cause.
4. DuckDB text-format (pre-0.10 fallback) splits box-wrapped expressions
   mid-token into separate filter expressions (reproduced:
   "filters:'1998-12-01' AS DATE)),(l_shipdate <= CAST(") making
   fingerprints depend on line-wrap width.

Findings: F4.2, F4.3, F4.4, F2.3.

anti_patterns.dont: encode errors in the data channel (error strings returned as plan text).

preserves.behavior: Display path (show_query_plans) stays best-effort: failures never abort query execution
strict_plan_capture still raises PlanCaptureError on capture failure

verifications.description: Cursor helper returns None on EXPLAIN failure
Corrupt companion produces distinguishable CLI message
Wrapped filter parses as one expression

work_units.notes: Helper now returns str | None (None + WARNING on failure), no longer the error text as plan. azure_synapse/firebolt annotations updated to str | None (the only helper delegators); display path already handled None. Out of scope: athena/presto/velox/_spark_helpers keep their own inline error-string impls (same F4.2 bug, tracked as a follow-up sweep).
work_units.summary: Create: get_query_plan_from_cursor returns None on failure and logs the exception; callers (trino/presto/athena/firebolt/azure_synapse display paths) handle None.

work_units.notes: _load_companion_file returns (data, error); load_result_file sets result.plans_load_error; show-plan/compare-plans print "plans file exists but failed to load: <reason>" vs the no-plan guidance. Absent companion keeps plans_load_error None (unchanged guidance).
work_units.summary: Create: corrupt companion files surface as warnings and a plans_load_error field; CLIs report load failure, not "no plans".

work_units.notes: expression_family records failures on self.plan_capture_errors + carries plan_capture_error on the query row, warned once per run. Scope-limited partial: threading the cause into the persisted .plans.json errors[] (normalize_query_result drop + benchmark_mixin existing_errors) and a per-run reset are out-of-scope follow-ups.
work_units.summary: Create: DataFrame capture failures recorded into a per-run capture-error list (mirroring _record_plan_capture_failure) so companion errors carry the real exception; warn once per run.

work_units.notes: _join_wrapped_expressions (paren-balance heuristic) rejoins box-wrapped fragments into one expression before recording; regression test on DUCKDB_0_9_FILTER_SCAN asserts one balanced filter expression.
work_units.summary: Create: DuckDB text parser joins box continuation lines before splitting expressions, with a wrapped-filter regression test.

work_units.notes: Opus review: CLEAN PASS, no code edits. Verified all four surfaces with adversarial probes; all four guard tests go red on revert; 310 passed; ruff/ty clean. Recorded out-of-scope follow-ups in the PR.
work_units.summary: Review: adversarial code review (message wording reachable from CLIs, no new crash paths on None plans).
Fix: address review findings; re-run verification.
